improvement.improvement_loop: Once the original C4 panel and exposure policy are recovered, iterate using only each original LOO fit’s training units and separately declared development feedback. Keep all observations of the left-out unit out of fitting and preserve the permitted unlabeled VAE corpus. Log classifier, probability calibration and confidence-rule changes without feeding external mouse/macaque evaluation labels into selection.
improvement.candidate_freeze: Before final LOO and transfer scoring, freeze the five-class ontology, complete unit roster, original QC and input conditions, VAE membership and initialization, per-fold fit recipe, ten-member probability reduction, confidence/coverage comparison, and budgets. The confidence threshold cannot be changed after seeing final labels to discard errors.
improvement.final_evaluation: Produce the complete original 202-unit LOO and external expert-population outputs with the recovered source recipe; report every class’s accuracy and retained fraction at the original confidence conditions. Admit victory only under a predeclared ordered comparison that prevents selective coverage gains. Grouped animal-held-out results are a separately named extension.
improvement.baseline_policy: Calibrate against the released author deep-classifier and its full confidence/coverage results. Preserve any label-conditioned engineered-feature baseline as a disclosed literal reconstruction; the local target-blind grouped successor cannot replace the paper comparator. Published figures, author reruns and prospective grouped references retain separate identities.
